headline: In Kazakhstan, arrests of top managers of large companies continue
summary: Arrests of top managers at large companies in Kazakhstan are continuing, according to 24.kg. The input does not name the companies or the charges.
why: Arrests of senior executives at large companies can raise governance and regulatory risk for investors exposed to Kazakhstan's corporate sector.
original_headline: В Казахстане продолжаются аресты топ-менеджеров крупных компаний
